lines.speaker: them
lines.text: It's a 2019 hatchback with 62 thousand kilometres, asking 14,500 euros.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Has it ever been in an accident?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: No accidents at all, one owner, full service history.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: I mean, a car like this, people are always asking, there's a lot of interest this week.
lines.label: evasion

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Can I see the service book?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Of course. It has 62,000 on the clock, as the advert says.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Fourteen and a half thousand, same as I said.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: I'd like it checked by a mechanic.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Fine, but the mileage is actually 85 thousand kilometres.
lines.label: number_drift

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: It was in a crash two years ago, the front was repaired.
lines.label: contradiction
